description.value:
Prerequisites: Dragoon 2 (1st rank), Dragoon 10 (2nd rank)

Gain a +1 bonus to your attack when attacking with a melee weapon that you are proficient with. This talent may be taken up to two times; the 1st rank being accessible at 2nd level or higher, and the 2nd rank at 10th level or higher. These effects stack with each other.
